title: Implement the initial processing pending boundary

gates.name: Python typecheck
gates.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m mypy src/face_moment

gates.name: Initial pending tests
gates.command: docker compose run --rm backend python -m pytest tests/processing/test_initial_pending.py

verify.summary: Compacted retained final functional PASS. Current task status is done.
Compacted final lifecycle closure: current task status is done.

evidence_required: .memory-bank/domains/photo-admission.md#face_momentphoto_pipeline_states RED: processing exposes no owner-controlled initial pending operation; GREEN: its typed application boundary creates exactly one serving-revision row with pending, attempt_count zero and a server timestamp inside a caller-supplied transaction; decisive comparison: caller commit retains the row and caller rollback removes it; artifact: migration and transaction-integration output.
purpose: Provide the processing-owned side of later atomic Photo publication without implementing the processing lifecycle.
success_outcome: Inventory can call one typed processing boundary that participates in its PostgreSQL transaction and creates exactly the canonical initial serving pending row.
anti_goals: Do not implement work claiming, inference, retry, terminal transitions, derivatives, faces or searchable publication.
Do not let inventory, handlers or shared helpers write photo_pipeline_states directly.

forbidden_scope: FT-002 processing lifecycle and FaceEngine behavior
Direct foreign writes or cross-owner cascades
stop_conditions: The initial row cannot participate in the caller transaction without changing the accepted application boundary.
A processing transition beyond initial pending becomes necessary.
The implementation would give inventory direct processing repository access.

constraints: processing owns the model, repository and typed initial-pending application boundary.
The row key is photo_id plus pipeline_revision_id and uses deliberate no-cross-owner-cascade behavior.
The boundary accepts the existing caller transaction rather than opening or committing a foreign transaction.
invariants: Initial status is pending, attempt_count is zero and the state timestamp is server assigned.
Caller rollback removes the pending row.
No later processing state or final face data is created.
verification_targets: Isolated migration and transaction-integration proof distinguishes caller commit from rollback and confirms the forbidden transition surface remains absent.
